about_short_description.short_description: Pi Flow operates as an accounting services provider.

product.name: Accounting Packages
product.description: Tiered accounting service packages tailored to company size and transaction volume, including bookkeeping, financial reporting, tax preparation, and monthly financial meetings.

product.name: Financial Statement Filing Service
product.description: Service to accurately prepare and upload financial statements to the Saudi Ministry of Commerce's Qawaem platform.

product.name: Accounting Tree Setup and Review
product.description: Service to prepare and evaluate the chart of accounts for accurate financial record-keeping.

product.name: Financial Reporting Preparation
product.description: Preparation of financial reports for past periods, ranging from one month up to two years.

product.name: Financial Modeling Workshop
product.description: A six-hour workshop focused on building financial models for startups and businesses.

product.name: Product Pricing Workshop
product.description: A six-hour workshop teaching product pricing strategies and techniques.
